pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: src/features/triggers/sub_studio/libs/triggerStudioConstants.ts:34 The Chain Studio rail offers the app_focus trigger on every host. Its rail filter (StudioRails.tsx:64) filters only by search text, while the native side returns None on every non-Windows host (src-tauri/engine/src/app_focus.rs:61, 'not yet implemented'), so a macOS or Linux user can commit a route that silently never fires.

techniques.evidence: src/features/triggers/sub_studio/libs/triggerStudioConstants.ts:34 This is a class-4 capability (absent on non-Windows) that is rendered unconditionally. No per-host presence matrix or predicate exists, and the backend's non-Windows branch is a silent no-op that returns None (app_focus.rs:61-64). That is the 'no-op that returns a lie' the technique names.
src/features/triggers/sub_studio/useStudioComposer.ts:122 The destructive rollback sends a native-issued trigger id, not a target list.

src-tauri/src/engine/subscription/desktop.rs:57 The watchers behind the studio's trigger types (clipboard, app focus) run as native subscriptions, not in the view, so they keep firing while the window is hidden. This anchor is the native half of this context's trigger types.

pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_context/ContextMapPage.tsx:362 The scan job is owned natively (BackgroundJobManager plus events), and the view holds no connection state: it resyncs from native job status on mount. The renderer-sent root path is confined component-wise to the project's registered root before a permission-disabled agent runs there.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_context/ContextMapPage.tsx:362 The view re-reads native job status after being away, so a completion it missed while unmounted still lands.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/context_generation.rs:735 The path is canonicalized, then compared with a component-wise Path::starts_with against the native-held project root (an allow-list that matches whole segments). Two small gaps: the UI still re-sends root_path, which native already holds (ContextMapPage.tsx:410), and line 740 returns the requested spelling rather than the canonical path.

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_context/ContextMapPage.tsx:684 The overlay is rendered inside the page and no point-under-cursor query runs against foreign apps.
